summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Partners in scope: Japan, South Korea, Australia, Gulf states (Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and others), Malaysia, Russia and other economically relevant partners, across three dimensions: ODA by donor (MoF Development Cooperation Reports FY 2022/23 and 2024/25, OECD DAC2A/CRS), labour demand and agreements (Japan-Nepal SSW Memorandum of Cooperation 2019 on MOFA Japan, Korea EPS G2G arrangement via DoFE EPS Korea Section, DoFE approvals by destination) and trade by partner (Department of Customs). Recipient (DCR, Nepal FY) and donor (OECD, calendar year) aid records must be kept separate. No values retrieved; partner rankings are pending.

findings.claim: ODA disbursements to Nepal by partner (Japan, Korea, Australia, Gulf funds, Russia, others) and grant/loan split, recipient-reported.
findings.note: DCR tables by development partner (18D-L01, L02, L03).

findings.claim: ODA to Nepal by donor, donor-reported (DAC2A/CRS), incl. non-DAC Gulf donors where they report.
findings.note: 18D-L04, L05; calendar year; keep separate from DCR.

findings.claim: Labour approvals (new and renewed) by destination country, ranking of destination partners.
findings.note: DoFE/MoLESS annual labour migration statistics by destination (18D-L11); excludes India.

findings.claim: Korea EPS: MoU date and renewal status, annual quota allocation to Nepal and actual departures.
findings.note: EPS Korea Section notices (18D-L09) and Korean MoEL/HRD Korea allocations (not yet leads).
findings.period: calendar years (Korean quota) and Nepal FY (departures)

findings.claim: Japan SSW: status of the 2019 MoC, SSW skills tests held in Nepal, and Nepali residents in Japan by status of residence.
findings.note: 18D-L06, L07, L08; Immigration Services Agency statistics by nationality (Japan calendar/half-year).

findings.claim: Other labour agreements: Nepal's bilateral labour agreements/MoUs with GCC states, Malaysia, Israel, UK (health workers), Australia and European countries, with signing dates and status.
findings.note: CESLAM inventory (18D-L13) to be verified against MoLESS texts.

findings.claim: Merchandise trade by partner (exports, imports) for non-India/China partners, and share of total.
findings.note: Department of Customs annual statistics (18D-L12), Nepal FY; Comtrade mirror data calendar year.

findings.claim: A partner is 'major' on a dimension if it ranks in the top group by that dimension's measure; the cut-off (top-k or cumulative share) will be fixed consistently with 16B's concentration metrics once data are retrieved.

Russia is profiled for trade and labour (including irregular recruitment to Russian armed forces reported in the media) only on the basis of documented Nepal government records; no inference about intentions.

data_gaps: Session WebSearch budget was exhausted before searches for this subagent could be run; Crossref/doi.org are blocked by the egress proxy. Leads marked 'catalog endpoint' are the unverified catalog URLs in research/sources/source_catalog.yaml, not search-located documents.
DoFE Labour Migration Report direct file not located; catalog endpoint only.
Department of Customs annual trade statistics file not located; catalog endpoint only.
Korean MoEL/HRD Korea EPS quota allocation by country not located.
Gulf donor (Saudi Fund, Kuwait Fund, Abu Dhabi Fund, Qatar) project records not located; not all report to OECD.
No primary text located for Nepal's labour agreements with GCC states, Malaysia, Israel or the UK.

assumptions.text: Recipient-reported (DCR, Nepal FY) and donor-reported (OECD, calendar year) ODA are kept as separate series.
DoFE approvals measure flows of documented non-India migrants only; stocks come from Census 2021 and host-country statistics.

challenges.text: Korea EPS and Japan SSW flows should be taken from both DoFE departures (Nepal FY) and host-country admissions (calendar year); differences reflect timing and coverage.
X04 lists 18D as support; Korea/Japan agreement status is a policy variable (legal event) distinct from labour demand volumes and should be recorded as a dated event record.
Source catalog lacks ids for Japan Immigration Services Agency, Korea MoEL/HRD Korea, and Gulf development funds; leads carry source_id null.

uncertainty: High. Only document locations were identified; the ranking of partners on each dimension is entirely pending. Several leads are catalog endpoints not verified by search because the web search budget was exhausted.

partner_profiles.method: For each partner: ODA (DCR and OECD separately), labour (agreement status, approvals/admissions), trade (exports/imports by Nepal FY), each with source lead and period basis; rank partners per dimension after retrieval.
